plan.notes: Official Wake Forest University 2026-2027 Academic Bulletin, Business and Enterprise Management B.S. (School of Business). The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence — collected as a single requirements block per coordinator 2026-10-09 convention. The bulletin states the major consists of 54 hours; ACC 111 and BEM 201 (listed under Prerequisites for Admission) count toward Core Requirements and are included in the 54. ECN 150 and MTH 111/112 are admission prerequisites not counted in the 54-hour major figure; they are included here as published requirements, bringing this seed to 61 credits. Choice slots: MTH 111 (4) or MTH 112; BEM 371 (3) or BEM 372 (3) — the bulletin leaves the 'or' course hours blank, recorded at the same hours as the primary course. The 9-hour concentration block lists Marketing, International Business, New Business Development, and Management Consulting areas; concentration must include at least one BEM elective course or CGS 260.
